_doc: Item Mastery (D-049). Every weapon, spell, shield, armor piece and accessory levels up with use. Each level adds stat_growth_per_level to its core stats; specific levels unlock the abilities listed in that item's own `mastery` track in items.json. Ability descriptions use {param} placeholders filled from the track entry ({param%} shows a fraction as a percent).

keen_edge.name: Keen Edge
keen_edge.description: +{crit%} critical hit chance with this weapon.

bleed.name: Rending Cuts
bleed.description: Hits make the target bleed for {dps} damage per second over {duration} s.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.description: Hits crack armor: -{armor} enemy armor for {duration} s.

stun.name: Concussion
stun.description: {chance%} chance per hit to stun the target for {duration} s.

knockback.name: Shove
knockback.description: Power attacks hurl enemies back and interrupt their attacks.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Swings sweep a {arc}° arc, hitting everyone in front of you.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Power attacks spin through every enemy around you.

ground_slam.name: Earthbreaker
ground_slam.description: Power attacks shatter the ground: {damage%} damage to all enemies within {radius} m.

dash_strike.name: Lunge
dash_strike.description: Power attacks lunge {distance} m forward, striking everything in the path.

cross_guard.name: Cross Guard
cross_guard.description: Dual wielding: hold the off-hand attack to cross both blades and block {block%} of incoming damage.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.description: Each hit within 2 s of the last speeds your attacks by {haste%} (up to {stacks} stacks).

lifesteal.name: Blood Drinker
lifesteal.description: Heal for {fraction%} of the damage dealt.

bullet_time.name: Hunter's Focus
bullet_time.description: At full draw the world slows to {scale%} speed.

pierce.name: Piercing
pierce.description: Shots pass through up to {count} enemies.

power_shot.name: Heartseeker
power_shot.description: Fully drawn shots deal +{bonus%} damage and knock the target back.

fire_arrows.name: Pitch Arrows
fire_arrows.description: Arrows set targets alight for {dps} damage per second over {duration} s.

burn.name: Ignite
burn.description: Targets burn for {dps} damage per second over {duration} s.

explode.name: Detonation
explode.description: Impacts explode for {damage%} damage to all enemies within {radius} m.

chain.name: Arc Chain
chain.description: Lightning chains to {jumps} more enemies within {radius} m.

chill.name: Frostbite
chill.description: Hits slow the target by {slow%} for {duration} s.

freeze.name: Deep Freeze
freeze.description: {chance%} chance to freeze the target solid for {duration} s.

poison.name: Toxin
poison.description: Poison deals {dps} damage per second for {duration} s, stacking {stacks} times.

homing.name: Seeker
homing.description: Projectiles curve toward the nearest enemy.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.description: Heal for {fraction%} of the damage dealt.

regen.name: Renewal
regen.description: Also heals {hps} health per second for {duration} s.

ward.name: Aegis Ward
ward.description: Casting also wards you: -{reduction%} damage taken for {duration} s.

bash.name: Shield Bash
bash.description: Blocking a melee hit stuns the attacker for {duration} s.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: After a block, your next attack within {duration} s is a guaranteed critical hit.

reflect.name: Spiked Rim
reflect.description: Blocked melee hits reflect {fraction%} of their damage to the attacker.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.description: Melee attackers take {damage} damage when they hit you.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Falling below 30% health instantly heals {heal} (once every {cooldown} s).

dodge.name: Evasion
dodge.description: {chance%} chance to avoid a hit entirely.

ember_touch.name: Ember Touch
ember_touch.description: Melee hits burn for {dps} damage per second over {duration} s.

blood_pact.name: Blood Pact
blood_pact.description: Melee hits heal you for {fraction%} of the damage dealt.
